title: 2026 U.S. State Electricity Rates & Top 300 Cities Utility Costs
subtitle: Clean EIA-861M residential electricity tariffs, monthly kWh usage, solar payback ROI & city utility bills across 52 U.S. jurisdictions and 300 cities.
description: Compiled and maintained by USA Smart Living (https://usasmartliving.com/datasets.html). Includes full state-by-state residential electricity rates (cents/kWh), average monthly consumption, deregulation status, grid operators, NREL peak sun hours, 30% ITC solar payback estimates, and Top 300 U.S. city monthly electric, natural gas, water, and internet utility benchmarks.
